idea-plugin.name: Koehler Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A deep-black dark theme inspired by the classic Vim koehler color scheme by Ron Aaron.

Highlights

  • Pure-black editor background (#000000) with #101010 UI chrome — ideal on OLED displays and easy on the eyes in dim rooms.
  • Vim koehler hue mapping: yellow bold keywords, blue comments and annotations, pink-red strings and numbers, pink methods and fields, white identifiers and class names, orange punctuation, light-gray caret.
  • Toned-down accents — saturation dialed back from Vim's vivid originals for sustained-use readability.
  • Consistent UI surfaces — settings dialogs, popups, menus, tool windows, terminal, and notifications all unified on the same palette. No stray Darcula-blue rows.
  • Dimmed editor chrome — folding lines, indent guides, whitespace dots, and scrollbars sit just above the background.
  • Restrained selection and highlight backgrounds — current line, identifier-under-caret, and search matches stay legible.

Activate

  • Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme: Koehler
  • Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Scheme: Koehler

No fonts, no icons, no keymap changes — just the theme and a matching editor scheme.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3

  • Shell script highlighting: keywords (if/then/fi/set/readonly/exit) now yellow, built-ins (echo/grep/sed/awk) bold green, variables cyan.
  • Fixed keyword color across all languages: was green, now correctly yellow to match Vim koehler.

1.0.2

  • Refined editor scheme: types cyan, keywords green, annotations magenta, dim highlights, error stripes, visible whitespace.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Koehler dark UI theme and matching editor color scheme.
